purpose: private per-root decision on whether an actual 3.1.3 path is safe enough for a definite known-near-miss FP

decisions.limit: read of an already loaded Role only; role update remains vulnerable
User.credential and invitation token fields in login response only
assistant detail read only; route guard plus workspace-scoped service lookup

decisions.reason: The token acceptance path is not a safe SSO sibling: it does not bind an IdP issuer/subject to the pending invitation, and the reviewed readUserByToken path alone does not prove expiry checking.
No 3.1.3 SSO callback path was found that binds the selected account to an issuer/subject tuple. Email or token checks alone are incomplete.
The log route has permission middleware, but that does not prove role and tenant scoping for the BullMQ job dashboard or its payloads.
An env-name allowlist and command flag checks do not constrain attacker-selectable npx package execution under the built-in executable list.
Neither guard checks the cwd field that is passed through to the final stdio process launch.

decisions.limit: workspace-scoped lookup helper only; not a claim about Realtime tool execution

decisions.reason: Path containment does not prevent write or extension-bearing SQL from reaching datasource.query.
secureFetch is a different HTTP client path; the model client does not call it, and HTTP_SECURITY_CHECK=false can remove its default deny list.
An adjacent route permission does not bind the upsert-history id or chatflowid to principal/workspace at the service sink.
A compile-time string type is not a runtime check for a JSON object reaching MongoDBMemory queries.
The helper is not called by the vulnerable browser loader; initial URL filtering alone would not cover redirects and browser subrequests.
User credential sanitization does not redact Variable.value in exportData; the snapshot has no proven variable-export redaction sibling.
The request identifiers and derived key do not bind the caller to the creator of the main prediction being aborted.
An authenticated workspace path does not establish that the public fallback only accepts public chatflows; the fallback has no isPublic guard.
